blocks.text: 1 Chronicles 22 contains 19 verses. It opens with: Then David said, This is the house of Jehovah God, and this is the altar of burnt-offering for Israel. It concludes with: Now set your heart and your soul to seek after Jehovah your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of Jehovah God, to bring the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of Jehovah.
